content:
{
  "project": "hive-research-gpu",
  "what_building": "This service is an automated research assistant that synthesizes state-of-the-art summaries from academic papers, specifically focusing on multi-agent systems and reinforcement learning. It utilizes a multi-stage pipeline to extract key information, identify knowledge gaps, and generate cited, evidence-based answers.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_paper_context",
    "generate_cited_summary",
    "identify_information_gaps",
    "formulate_refined_queries"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "paper_title",
    "paper_content",
    "numbered_context_excerpts",
    "research_question",
    "partial_draft_answer"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "research_briefing",
    "cited_claims",
    "json_object_with_refined_queries"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Answer using ONLY the numbered context excerpts provided. Cite every claim with its excerpt number like [1] or [2][5].",
    "List up to 3 specific information gaps as refined arXiv-style search queries. Return JSON: {\"queries\": [\"...\"]}",
    "Write a thorough research briefing on: Summarize the state of multi-agent debat",
    "Title: SWE-Debate: Competitive Multi-Agent Debate for Software Issue Resolution"
  ]
}
